name: Meguro
tagline: Shibuya in 7 minutes and Shinagawa in 8 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where JR East, Tokyu, Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 7 minutes to Shibuya and 8 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 30.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 26.4 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.1 m to 30.5 m, a difference of 26.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 目黒太鼓橋

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 青葉会五反田神経内科病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is NTT東日本関東病院, about 16 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and Tokyu Meguro Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line, Tokyu runs 1 line, Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line runs at 156% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 駒込→本駒込, which this station is not on. Toei Mita Line runs at 146%. Its busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is likewise not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. 4 lines and a wide choice of connections pushes the figure up. On the other side, a climb from the station to much of the housing holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Fudo-Mae; for how close the centre is, Meguro.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Meguro. Both have the Tokyu Meguro Line. Meguro also has the JR Yamanote Line, Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line, which Fudo-Mae does not. Meguro is at least 7 minutes quicker to Shinjuku and Shinagawa. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥19,000 less at Fudo-Mae.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Shirokanedai; for how close the centre is, Meguro.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Meguro in a straight line. Both have the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line. Meguro also has the JR Yamanote Line and Tokyu Meguro Line, which Shirokanedai does not. Meguro is at least 8 minutes quicker to Shinagawa and Shibuya. A one-room flat also costs about ¥14,000 more at Shirokanedai. On safety, though, Shirokanedai comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
notFor: People who would rather not walk up and down slopes
noiseSources: The 首都高速2号目黒線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
目黒通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: This station sits on the busiest stretch of the Tokyu Meguro Line, but at 133% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
